seoTitle: How to Add a TradingView Widget to Your Website
metaDescription: Learn how to generate a TradingView widget, customize the symbol, timeframe, and theme, and embed the code on WordPress, HTML, or any website.
intro: Embedding a live TradingView widget lets you show real-time charts, tickers, or market data directly on your website or blog without building your own charting tool. This guide covers generating the widget, customizing its settings, and embedding the code on common platforms.

steps.heading: Create a TradingView widget
steps.body: Use TradingView's widget generator to choose the type of widget you want, such as a live chart, ticker tape, or market overview.

steps.heading: Customize the settings
steps.body: Set the default symbol, timeframe, color theme, and size so the widget matches your site's design and the data you want to highlight.

steps.heading: Copy the embed code
steps.body: Once configured, copy the generated HTML/JavaScript embed code provided by TradingView.

steps.heading: Add it to your website
steps.body: Paste the embed code into an HTML block on WordPress, a custom HTML widget, or directly into your site's page code, depending on your platform.

steps.heading: Fix common widget errors
steps.body: If the widget doesn't load, check for conflicting scripts, ad blockers, or a page builder stripping the script tag, and confirm the embed code was pasted in full.

faq.question: Is the TradingView widget free to embed?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView's basic widgets are free to generate and embed on any website.

faq.question: Can I add a TradingView widget to WordPress without a plugin?
faq.answer: Yes, most WordPress themes and the block editor support a custom HTML block where you can paste the widget embed code directly.

faq.question: Why is my TradingView widget not loading?
faq.answer: This is often caused by a page builder stripping script tags, an ad blocker, or pasting incomplete embed code — double-check the full code was inserted.

faq.question: Can I change the widget's symbol or theme later?
faq.answer: Yes, you can regenerate the widget with new settings and replace the old embed code with the updated version.
